items.title: Huntington Ingalls Industries (HII) Expands Unmanned Systems Plant, Is The Stock A Bargain?
items.summary: Huntington Ingalls Industries (HII) just cut the ribbon on a 10,000 square foot expansion to its unmanned maritime systems plant in Pocasset, Massachusetts, putting fresh attention on how the stock reflects this growing line of work. items.title: Inside Huntington Ingalls Industries (HII)’s Latest Pentagon Win: Long Lead Materials, Long Runway to 2039
items.summary: On September 4, the U.S. Department of War (DoW) announced a $336,112,000 Navy contract for Huntington Ingalls Industries, Inc. (NYSE:HII) to advance procurement of long-lead materials for the construction of the future USS William J. Clinton (CVN 82).
